Vehicle Rental Portal

LogisticsFleet ManagementIoT

Pain Point

Iveco had to build integrated system to manage truck rentals, facing issues with fragmented lease reservations, limited visibility into vehicle status, and scattered communication. Off-the-shelf solutions failed to meet these combined needs efficiently.

Solution

Etere Studio built a distributed, service-oriented platform to unify reservations, vehicle telemetry, and communication into a cohesive, scalable system. Microservices structured for core domains: reservations, telematics, comms Event-driven architecture enabling asynchronous, decoupled processing IoT gateways feeding real-time vehicle data into a centralized telemetry pipeline API-first design ensuring extensibility and seamless third-party integration

Highlights

  • Microservices structured for core domains: reservations, telematics, comms
  • Event-driven architecture enabling asynchronous, decoupled processing
  • IoT gateways feeding real-time vehicle data into a centralized telemetry pipeline
  • API-first design ensuring extensibility and seamless third-party integration
